# The Outlook From-line helper move preserves its definitions and caller contracts

The IsAFromSpaceLine and EscapeFromSpaceLine definitions moved from nsMsgUtils to nsOutlookCompose without changing their function bytes. The accepted source keeps those definitions. The line-oriented composition caller invokes EscapeFromSpaceLine for each CRLF-terminated line and ignores its return value, while dest_Stream::Append returns the helper result. Its comment explains that const_cast remains because the unchanged helper takes a mutable pointer without modifying the data. The move removes shared-header exposure but adds neither static nor anonymous-namespace linkage. It adds no tests and establishes no new parser robustness or general helper-placement rule.

Scope: mailnews-import.
